data.body_html:
Starlite Festival 2046 is the summer's hottest ticket on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to start the evening than with a pre-concert cruise from Puerto Banús. Imagine sipping cava as the sun dips behind La Concha, the sea turning gold, and you're just 10 minutes from the festival gates. Our Marbella boat rental service makes it effortless – here's how to plan the perfect Starlite pre-concert cruise.

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Works

Starlite is an open-air venue in the hills above Marbella, so the evening starts with a transfer from the coast. By booking a 2-hour cruise before the show, you turn a simple commute into a highlight of your trip. You get the sea breeze, the sunset, and a relaxed start – then you arrive at the venue with that holiday glow. It's a practical way to make the most of Marbella's best asset: the Mediterranean.

Our cruises depart from Puerto Banús, the marina that's synonymous with luxury. From there, you can sail west towards Cabopino or east towards the Golden Mile – both routes offer stunning coastal views. The skipper will tailor the route to the weather and your preferences, always keeping an eye on the clock so you dock in time for the concert.

Timing Your Cruise for Sunset

In July and August, sunset in Marbella is around 21:30. For a typical Starlite evening, we recommend boarding at 18:00 and cruising until 20:00. This gives you two full hours of golden light, a chance to swim if you fancy, and enough time to dock, freshen up, and grab a taxi to the venue. If you prefer a longer pre-party, consider a 4-hour charter starting at 16:00 – you'll have time for a late afternoon dip and a more leisurely sail.

Our team can also advise on the best boarding time based on the specific concert schedule – just ask when you book. We'll make sure you're never rushing.

Boat Options for Your Group

We have a fleet of 17 boats, but for a pre-concert cruise, these are the standouts:

For a couple or a small group, the Astondoa 40 is ideal – it's fast, stylish, and has a spacious cockpit for socialising. The Azimut 39 offers similar performance with a slightly different layout. If you're celebrating a special occasion or want to impress clients, the Mangusta 80 (24m) comes with a free jet ski and a crew that will pamper you. Other boats like the Pershing 46 or Fairline Targa are available on request – just message us for a quote.

What's Included – No Surprises

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). That means the price you see is the final price. No extra charges for ice, no hidden fuel fees. Just bring your sunglasses and a light jacket for the evening breeze.

For the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, the 2-hour rate is €749, and the 8-hour rate is €2,299. The Mangusta 80 has a 4-hour minimum at €4,719, which includes the jet ski – a fun addition if you want to get the adrenaline going before the concert.

How to Get to Starlite After Your Cruise

Once you dock back in Puerto Banús, the festival venue is about 6 km away – a 10-minute drive. We can arrange a private transfer for you (at cost), or you can easily grab a taxi from the marina. If you're coming in a group, we recommend booking a minivan in advance, as taxis can be scarce on concert nights. Our team can handle all of this for you – just let us know when you book.

If you're staying in Marbella's Golden Mile or the town centre, you can also walk to the venue from some hotels, but the transfer from the marina is quickest.

Book Your Starlite Pre-Concert Cruise

Starlite 2046 runs from early July to late August, and weekends sell out fast. To secure your boat, contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date and group size. For the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, you can also book directly through our website – just select your date and pay a deposit. All other boats are priced on request, so get in touch for a tailored quote.

Don't miss the chance to turn a concert night into a full Mediterranean experience. Start with the sea, then let the music take over. Check out our Marbella boat rental hub for more ideas, or browse our blog for other cruise inspiration.
